rules.condition: during reset and in the cycle that ends at R1
rules.statement: o_s_axi_awready, o_s_axi_wready and o_s_axi_arready must be 0 during reset and in the cycle that ends at R1, and 1 from R1.
The readies must be registered and depend only on the held state, not on the valids.

rules.condition: write response after the later of the AW and W transfers (Ec)
rules.statement: bvalid must be 1 from Ec, giving a write response latency of exactly 1 cycle.

rules.condition: read response after the address transfer (Ear)
rules.statement: rvalid must be 1 from Ear, giving a read data latency of exactly 1 cycle.
The register must be written at Ec, the later of the AW and W transfers.

rules.condition: a read and a write of the same register overlap
rules.statement: The read must sample the register at Ear: a write at the same edge gives the old value, a write at an earlier Ec gives the new value.
i_status must be sampled at Ear and the sampled value held until Er.
Address bits [PARA_ADDR_W-1:2] must be fully decoded; any 1 above bit 6 makes the address unmapped.
bresp, rresp and rdata must be 0 during reset; their values while valid is 0 outside reset are not specified or checked.

rules.condition: after a B or R transfer
rules.statement: The readies must return to 1 in the cycle after the B or R transfer, with no combinational path from bready or rready.
The RTL should stop elaboration with an error on illegal parameter values.
A reset must end every held state; "after R1" means the most recent R1.
Reset must be applied from time zero for at least 2 cycles; outputs are undefined and unchecked before the first reset.

rules.condition: request in progress across a reset
rules.statement: Reset ends the obligation on a pending request; a valid after R1 must be treated as a new request.
